vb_textbox.text: Pick a colour from the pair of gnomes (such as red or green, brown or purple). If this is a low number, try the other colour from the pair next time. Once you get a high number, stick with that colour and you will see that the number usually goes down throughout the rounds. Once that colour is a low number, switch to trying the other colour from the pair. For example, out of a pair of red and green gnomes, you pick red. Red is one. Next time, choose green. Green is seven. Then keep picking green. You may get six, then five, then four and so on. Once you get to one or two, start choosing red again. Also, take note of any patterns that emerge while playing and be responsive to those but this is a great starting point.
